parameters.query:
-- Deja el turno al final del hilo que ya tenia la conversacion.
-- La foto no se copia aqui: ya vive en conversaciones.imagen_base64 y meterla
-- en cada mensaje haria crecer la fila sin necesidad. En el historial solo
-- queda la marca de que ese mensaje traia una.
-- La fila la crea el flujo del chat al primer mensaje; aqui solo se anade, y
-- unicamente si la conversacion es de quien la manda.
UPDATE conversaciones
SET historial_mensajes = historial_mensajes || $3::jsonb,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND (usuario_id IS NULL OR usuario_id = $2::uuid)
RETURNING session_id, jsonb_array_length(historial_mensajes) AS mensajes_guardados;

-- Hilo guardado de una conversacion, solo para su dueno.
-- imagen_base64 viaja aparte porque el historial guarda la marca del mensaje
-- con foto, no la foto en si.
SELECT session_id, estado, historial_mensajes, imagen_base64, updated_at
FROM conversaciones
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND (usuario_id IS NULL OR usuario_id = $2::uuid);
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM reports;
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total FROM reports WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours';

SELECT incident_type AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE incident_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY incident_type
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT severity AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE severity IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM reports
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (punto_nombre) punto_nombre, porcentaje_congestion, estado
  FROM traffic_readings
  ORDER BY punto_nombre, captured_at DESC
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(porcentaje_congestion)::numeric, 1) AS congestion_promedio,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'Congestionado')::int AS puntos_congestionados,
  COUNT(*)::int AS total_puntos
FROM latest;

SELECT distrito AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM siniestros_fatales
WHERE distrito IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY distrito
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT clase_siniestro AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos
FROM siniestros_fatales
WHERE clase_siniestro IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY clase_siniestro
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos_total
FROM siniestros_fatales;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos_total, COALESCE(SUM(heridos), 0)::int AS heridos_total
FROM siniestros_sutran;

SELECT departamento AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value
FROM siniestros_sutran
WHERE departamento IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY departamento
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT modalidad AS name, COUNT(*)::int AS value, COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0)::int AS fallecidos
FROM siniestros_sutran
WHERE modalidad IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY modalidad
ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT r.id, r.description, r.incident_type, r.severity, r.priority, r.status,
       r.latitude, r.longitude, r.created_at, r.resolved_at,
       (r.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tiene_imagen,
       u.email AS reportado_por
FROM reports AS r
LEFT JOIN usuarios AS u ON u.id = r.usuario_id
WHERE r.latitude IS NOT NULL AND r.longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

-- El historial es privado: solo devuelve los reportes del usuario que lo pide.
-- El operador, que atiende los de toda la ciudad, sigue viendo todos.
-- Sin un usuario_id valido no sale ninguna fila, asi que el historial queda
-- vacio para quien no ha iniciado sesion.
WITH solicitante AS (
  SELECT id, role FROM usuarios WHERE id = $1::uuid
)
SELECT r.id, r.description, r.incident_type, r.severity, r.priority, r.status,
       r.latitude, r.longitude, r.created_at, r.resolved_at,
       (r.image_url IS NOT NULL) AS tiene_imagen,
       u.email AS reportado_por
FROM reports AS r
LEFT JOIN usuarios AS u ON u.id = r.usuario_id
WHERE r.usuario_id = (SELECT id FROM solicitante)
   OR (SELECT role FROM solicitante) = 'operador'
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
SELECT id, image_url FROM reports WHERE id = $1;

-- Cada quien resuelve sus propios reportes; el operador, cualquiera.
-- Si el reporte no es suyo no se actualiza ninguna fila y la respuesta vuelve
-- vacia, que es como el frontend detecta que el cambio no se aplico.
UPDATE reports AS r
SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'resuelto' THEN 'resuelto' ELSE 'pending' END,
    resolved_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'resuelto' THEN now() ELSE NULL END
WHERE r.id = $1::uuid
  AND (r.usuario_id = $3::uuid
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usuarios AS o
                  WHERE o.id = $3::uuid AND o.role = 'operador'))
RETURNING r.id, r.status, r.resolved_at;

WITH clustered AS (
  SELECT
    codigo_siniestro,
    geom,
    fallecidos,
    ST_ClusterDBSCAN(geom, eps := $1, minpoints := $2) OVER () AS cluster_id
  FROM siniestros_fatales
  WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
),
agrupado AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cantidad,
    COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0) AS fallecidos_total,
    ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geom))) AS lon,
    ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geom))) AS lat
  FROM clustered
  WHERE cluster_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cluster_id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'type', 'FeatureCollection',
  'features', COALESCE(json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'type', 'Feature',
      'geometry', json_build_object(
        'type', 'Point',
        'coordinates', json_build_array(lon, lat)
      ),
      'properties', json_build_object(
        'cluster_id', cluster_id,
        'cantidad_siniestros', cantidad,
        'fallecidos_total', fallecidos_total
      )
    )
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS geojson
FROM agrupado;

WITH centroides(departamento, lon, lat) AS (
  VALUES
    ('AMAZONAS', -77.9, -5.9), ('ANCASH', -77.6, -9.3), ('APURIMAC', -72.9, -14.0),
    ('AREQUIPA', -72.2, -15.8), ('AYACUCHO', -73.9, -13.9), ('CAJAMARCA', -78.6, -6.7),
    ('CALLAO', -77.1, -12.0), ('CUSCO', -71.9, -13.4), ('HUANCAVELICA', -74.9, -12.9),
    ('HUANUCO', -76.2, -9.6), ('ICA', -75.5, -14.3), ('JUNIN', -75.2, -11.7),
    ('LA LIBERTAD', -78.6, -7.9), ('LAMBAYEQUE', -79.8, -6.5), ('LIMA', -76.9, -12.05),
    ('LORETO', -74.0, -4.5), ('MADRE DE DIOS', -70.1, -12.3), ('MOQUEGUA', -70.9, -17.1),
    ('PASCO', -75.9, -10.5), ('PIURA', -80.4, -5.3), ('PUNO', -70.1, -15.5),
    ('SAN MARTIN', -76.6, -7.0), ('TACNA', -70.3, -17.9), ('TUMBES', -80.4, -3.6),
    ('UCAYALI', -74.4, -8.9)
),
agregado AS (
  SELECT departamento,
         translate(UPPER(TRIM(departamento)), 'ÁÉÍÓÚÑ', 'AEIOUN') AS departamento_normalizado,
         COUNT(*) AS cantidad,
         COALESCE(SUM(fallecidos), 0) AS fallecidos_total,
         COALESCE(SUM(heridos), 0) AS heridos_total
  FROM siniestros_sutran
  WHERE departamento IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY departamento
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'type', 'FeatureCollection',
  'features', COALESCE(json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'type', 'Feature',
      'geometry', json_build_object(
        'type', 'Point',
        'coordinates', json_build_array(
          COALESCE(c.lon, -76.0),
          COALESCE(c.lat, -10.0)
        )
      ),
      'properties', json_build_object(
        'departamento', s.departamento,
        'cantidad_siniestros', s.cantidad,
        'fallecidos_total', s.fallecidos_total,
        'heridos_total', s.heridos_total,
        'ubicacion_aproximada', c.departamento IS NULL
      )
    )
  ), '[]'::json)
) AS geojson
FROM agregado s
LEFT JOIN centroides c ON s.departamento_normalizado = c.departamento;
